name: Jac
caption: If you've ever felt like the only one awake in the room, this one's for you. Comment "awake" 🤍

slides.text:
Nobody warns you how lonely waking up is.

(For the ones who see it.)

In 2020, the world stopped.

For the first time in my life, I actually had time to think.

So I started asking questions nobody around me was asking.

Why am I always tired?

Why does all my food come in a box?

Whose life am I even chasing?

And once you start seeing it… you can't stop.

The hardest part wasn't the truth.

It was sitting at the dinner table with the people I love most, and being the only one who saw it.

Not angry. Just alone in the room.

But here's what nobody tells you either:

You were never alone.

There are others. Quiet. Questioning. Connecting the same dots you are.

You're not crazy. You're awake.

I'm building a home for the others.

If you felt this, follow along.

Comment "awake" so we can find each other.
